prompt: Whales have small pelvic bones embedded in their body wall that are not used for walking. Why do biologists treat these bones as evidence about whale ancestry?

options.text: They show whales are closely related to fish, which also have pelvic fins
They are new bones that whales are evolving for future use on land
They are vestigial remains of the pelvis that supported hind legs in the land-dwelling ancestors of whales
They prove whales never had ancestors with legs, because the bones do nothing

explanation: A reduced, functionless version of a structure that was fully functional in ancestors is a vestigial structure. The whale pelvis matches the hind-limb support of land mammals, consistent with whales descending from four-legged land ancestors.
